name: TC-24 Verify carousel navigation using left and right arrows
description: Verify that 'Інші новини' carousel can be navigated using arrows.
descriptionHtml: Verify that 'Інші новини' carousel can be navigated using arrows.

Click left arrow in news carousel
Wait for carousel cards to slide to previous
